summary: Phase S3 adversarial acceptance passes. The focused Red-to-Green oracle exercises the former review failures directly: cross-school and actor mismatch, null tenant, cross-owner and owner-chain foreign keys, immutable retarget protection, caller digest spoofing, concurrent duplicate replay, stale CAS, mid-transaction rollback, malformed inputs, calibration release gates, provider error mapping, natural uniqueness, and snapshot/journal drift.
evidence: The remediation Red oracle began with 42 audited failures and 13 passing controls across five new test files; every failure is now Green without removing the protected behavior.

mastery-persistence-drizzle-adversarial.test.ts proves bound authority, actual TenantDB reuse, immutable identities, rollback, concurrent applied/replayed receipts, stale conflicts, and portable provider failures.
mastery-persistence-tenant-adversarial.test.ts proves PostgreSQL/PGlite composite user, card, review, and evidence ownership constraints with same-school controls.
mastery-persistence-remediation-contract.test.ts proves canonical schemas, internally derived digests, identifier parity, calibration invariants, and retryable errors.
mastery-persistence-migration-repro.test.ts proves restored natural uniqueness and the 0026-0028 migration/snapshot/journal chain.
